source_quote: Accurate strand origin information maintained using dUTP incorporation during second strand synthesis. | The strand marked with dUTP is not amplified, allowing strand-specific sequencing.
evidence_note: KR1352 is the document code, not the catalog number. Roche publishes newer instructions for use (not retrieved here). source_quote: dUTP, NSR, NNSR | Equivalently, it is assumed that only the strand generated during first strand synthesis is sequenced.
evidence_note: Used only when the notes describe dUTP second-strand marking but name no kit. dUTP marking alone fixes which strand is sequenced, not which read it lands in; RF assumes standard Illumina Y-adapter ligation, which is the convention in TopHat's library-type table. Illumina KB #2238 documents the same result for its dUTP workflows.
